exceptions.reason: Path traversal when unpacking an OCI archive (fixed in 0.4.1). intel-mkl-src 0.8.1, the MKL backend of ndarray-linalg (feature intel-mkl-static), uses ocipkg 0.2.x only as a build-dependency: its build script downloads the MKL static libraries from the project's OCI registry. intel-mkl-src cannot move to ocipkg 0.4.1. No shipped library contains ocipkg. Granted by the repository owner on 2026-11-17 for seven days; remove it once the MKL backend no longer needs ocipkg 0.2.x.
